architecture.confidence_policy: coverage/source freshness may be displayed, but no probability or calibrated confidence claim without separate validation
architecture.direction: positive = easier/more favorable; negative = harder/less favorable
architecture.missing_data_policy: show unavailable; never impute neutral matchup
architecture.normalization: Within position bucket and source snapshot only. No cross-position raw-scale comparison.
architecture.schedule_join_key: NFL team + opponent + week + position bucket

window_blending.reason: Near-term, ROS, and playoff utility answer different decisions and must remain separately visible in V1.

fantasy_playoffs.definition: explicit configured league playoff weeks only; no hard-coded playoff weeks if league configuration is absent

rest_of_season.definition: all remaining fantasy-relevant regular-season games excluding configured fantasy-playoff weeks

identity_policy.multi_position_players: use the deployed valuation/eligibility bucket selected by current production identity rules; do not choose the easiest matchup bucket

primary_purpose: Display-only schedule context for near-term, rest-of-season, and fantasy-playoff matchup difficulty. Schedule Utility is a separate decision-support lens and is not part of Fundamental Value.

scientific_sequence.goal: prove 4for4 aFPA/Hot Spots can be captured, normalized, joined to schedule, and summarized without licensing leakage
scientific_sequence.name: private source ingestion feasibility

scientific_sequence.goal: measure coverage, source freshness, position/team gaps, and aFPA-vs-Hot-Spots agreement before any outcome test
scientific_sequence.name: coverage and disagreement audit

scientific_sequence.goal: test whether preregistered schedule signals predict future player fantasy production after controlling for baseline role/value
scientific_sequence.name: retrospective predictive validation

scientific_sequence.goal: freeze live weekly schedule scores before games and evaluate only subsequently realized weeks
scientific_sequence.name: prospective shadow

scientific_sequence.goal: consider UI promotion only if validation is positive; no FV blending is authorized by V1
scientific_sequence.name: display-only production consideration
